title: 第22章 售卖野物，和大壮分账

第22章 售卖野物，和大壮分账-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“二大娘，还在这站着干嘛，又没你的碗筷！”

“待会我们吃完了，这些鸡骨头什么的你去捡起来嗦嗦味，也不是不可以的。”

李青山再次开口道。

吃过的鸡骨头？

捡起来嗦嗦味道？

李青山的话，顿时让吴秀有些无地自容，指着李青山道：“好啊，你个败家子，你们就这么吃吧，我看你们你把这些肉全部吃完了，还能吃什么！”

“到时候回来求我们进家门，求我们施舍！”

“你们是想也别想！”

“哼1！”

吴秀说完，便气冲冲的回到了房间里。

“娘的，李青山这小子还真是狼心狗肺，怎么说我也是他二大爷，你也是他二大娘，竟然真的一点都不给我们吃？”

“等着吧！”

“哼，我就不信这点野物，没有吃完的时候。”

“就这个小狼崽子这么浪费，用不了多久，就有的他们哭了。”

二大爷望着窗外的李青山，还有那喷香喷香的鸡肉，兔子肉，忍不住骂道。

“你就是再叫唤，咱们家也没有肉吃。”

“没用的东西，我当初怎么就嫁给你了呢？”

吴秀忍不住骂道。

“臭婆娘，你说什么？”

‘我说什么，我说你，你怎么就不能让我吃上肉？’

“嘿，臭婆娘，翻了天啊，看我不抽死你……！”

顿时。

房间内传来一阵阵家暴的声音。

“我看，还是算了吧！”

“我就算是出去，李青山这小狼崽子也不可能给咱们肉吃。”

老大家的媳妇，孙兰望着外面发生的一幕，开口说道。

“这小崽子，怎么突然就变得这么硬气了呢？”李大奎望着外面的李青山，心中升起一抹怨气。

打了这么多野物，凭什么就不能给自己的大爷，二大爷分一分？

两家人一起坐了下来，嫂子柳桂香则是坐在李青山身旁，窈窕的身段，还有那好生养的屁股，二人紧紧挨着！！

“娘，东西都上齐了吧？”李青山开口问道。

“嗯，都齐了！！”

青山娘点了点头道。

今天晚上这顿饭，一共是炒了两只鸡，炖了两只兔子，一只果子狸，肯定是够吃了。

等到明天，李青山便让娘将剩下的野鸡，再抓两只兔子处理掉，过油炸一下，然后放在阴凉通风的地方，最少还能放个两天，差不多也就吃完了。

除此之外，还剩下几只兔子，全部烟熏风干。

或者用盐腌了！

明天上集市，李青山就打算将三只狍子肉，还有那只貉子卖掉，野鸡和野兔全部自己吃了。

自己如今上山打猎这运气和手段。

完全没必要太对不起自己，这次主要还是因为人手不够，否则自己在山上多待几天，啥都有了。

还有欠李虎的四十块钱。

说好了一个月的期限，现在才过去多久，完全没必要着急，先吃饱饭，将身体养好了，才能打更多的猎物。

那四十块钱，不是轻轻松松吗？

只要打到一头二百多斤的小野猪，就差不多够了。

当然了。

野猪不好打，特别是自己手中用的是猎弓，不是猎枪……！

但要是让自己遇见了，也绝对不会放过便是了。

“爹娘，叔婶，别客气了，赶紧吃起来吧！”李青山开口招呼道。

“来来来，别客气……！”

李三奎也早已按捺不住内心的激动，开始下了筷子。

两家人热闹了起来。

平日里，这些肉大家都是吃不上的，就算是家里的鸡下了蛋，那第一件事情也不是做个早餐，而是积攒在一起，拿到集市上卖了去。

一个个筷子夹得飞快。

狼吞虎咽。

特别是李青山的炒鸡，最受欢迎。

柳桂香平日里吃饭都是小心翼翼的，毕竟在老李家，她的地位是最低的，吃饭的时候筷子只敢去夹咸菜，也只能去夹咸菜。

如今望着眼前的兔肉，鸡肉和果子狸。

也是小心翼翼的，不太敢伸手，吃的自然也就比较慢了，要是这么下去的话，柳桂香肯定也吃不了多少的。

"Second aunt, why are you still standing here? I don't have your bowls and chopsticks!"

"When we finish eating later, it's not impossible for you to pick up these chicken bones and taste them."

Li Qingshan spoke again.

Eaten chicken bones?

Does it smell like something when you pick it up?

Li Qingshan's words immediately made Wu Xiu feel ashamed. He pointed at Li Qingshan and said: "Okay, you prodigal son, just eat like this. I see you have eaten all this meat, what else can you eat!"

"When the time comes, come back and beg us to come into your home and beg us for alms!"

"Don't even think about it!"

"Hmph 1!"

After Wu Xiu finished speaking, he returned to the room angrily.

"Damn, this guy Li Qingshan is really a wolf-hearted guy. How can I say that I am also his second uncle, and you are also his second eldest wife, but you really don't give us any food?"

"Just wait!"

"Hmph, I don't believe that this wild thing is not eaten until it's finished."

"If this little wolf is so wasteful, it won't be long before some of them are crying."

The second uncle looked at Li Qingshan outside the window and the fragrant chicken and rabbit meat, and couldn't help but curse.

"Even if you keep yelling, our family won't have any meat to eat."

"Useless thing, why did I marry you in the first place?"

Wu Xiu couldn't help but curse.

"Smelly bitch, what did you say?"

‘What am I talking about? Why can’t you let me eat meat?’

"Hey, stinky bitch, what a mess, let's see if I don't beat you to death...!"

Suddenly.

There were sounds of domestic violence in the room.

"I think it's better to forget it!"

"Even if I go out, there is no way that little wolf Li Qingshan can give us meat to eat."

The boss's wife, Sun Lan, looked at the scene happening outside and said.

"Why did this little brat suddenly become so tough?" Li Dakui looked at Li Qingshan outside, feeling resentful in his heart.

After killing so many wild animals, why can't I give one point to my uncle and second uncle?

The two families sat down together, and sister-in-law Liu Guixiang sat next to Li Qingshan, with her slim figure and that fertile ass, the two of them were close to each other!!

"Mom, are everything here?" Li Qingshan asked.

"Well, it's all ready!!"

Qingshan Niang nodded.

Tonight's meal consisted of two stir-fried chickens, two stewed rabbits, and one civet, which was definitely enough to eat.

Waiting until tomorrow, Li Qingshan will ask his mother to catch the remaining pheasants and two rabbits, fry them, and then put them in a cool and ventilated place. They can be kept for at least two days, and they are almost finished.

In addition, there are a few rabbits left, all smoked and dried.

Or salted!

When he goes to the market tomorrow, Li Qingshan plans to sell the meat of the three roe deer and the raccoon dog, and eat all the pheasants and rabbits himself.

I now have the luck and means to go hunting in the mountains.

There is absolutely no need to feel too sorry for myself. This time it was mainly because of the lack of manpower. Otherwise, if I had stayed on the mountain for a few more days, I would have had everything.

There is also forty yuan owed to Li Hu.

The deadline of one month has been agreed upon, but it has only passed now. There is no need to be anxious. First, eat enough and take good care of your body before you can hunt more prey.

Isn't that forty yuan easy?

As long as you kill a small wild boar weighing more than 200 kilograms, that's almost enough.

Of course.

Wild boars are difficult to shoot, especially when you are using a hunting bow, not a shotgun...!

But if I were to meet him, I would never let him go.

"Mom, dad, uncle, aunt, don't be polite, hurry up and eat!" Li Qingshan greeted.

"Come on, come on, you're welcome...!"

Li Sankui could no longer suppress his excitement and began to take off his chopsticks.

The two families became lively.

On weekdays, no one can eat this kind of meat. Even if the chickens at home lay eggs, the first thing is not to make breakfast, but to save them together and sell them in the market.

The chopsticks picked each one up very quickly.

wolf.

Especially Li Qingshan’s fried chicken is the most popular.

Liu Guixiang was always careful when eating. After all, she had the lowest status in Lao Li's family. When eating, she only dared to pick up pickles with her chopsticks.

Now I look at the rabbit, chicken and civet in front of me.

He was also cautious, not daring to reach out, so he naturally ate more slowly. If this continued, Liu Guixiang would definitely not be able to eat much.
